maya-mktg: Flagging a weird blip in this week's KPI deck  — social launch posts showing big CTR lifts but the 'new MQLs' card is flat. Can ops/analytics sanity-check tagging? :mag:
eli-ops: Noted. I'm seeing an inbound parser tweak that normalized utm_term last night; could be collapsing campaign variants. Digging into the routing logs now.
frank-analytics: Quick snapshot: clicks -> regs up 60%, registrations = 782, but MQLs only 34. Historical expectation for this cohort ~ 82 MQLs. Raw pipeline: `events.ingest_v=42` query in progress.
lena-growth: Could the marketing SDK drop a param on mobile web? We had a mobile fix last week. If utm_campaign missing downstream, the dashboard filter might classify as "unknown".
eli-ops: Sharing routing grep: ```bash
# inbound routing mapping lines
2026-03-22T23:11Z map: utm_campaign=promo_spring_v3 -> nurture
2026-03-22T23:11Z map: utm_campaign=launch_social_v2 -> sales
```
eli-ops: But I also see a fallback that maps empty campaign -> 'unknown' which the KPI card filters out. That could explain the undercount.
frank-analytics: Good catch. Can you dump counts by routed_tag? I'll produce a small join and drop-in to the deck.
frank-analytics: SQL snippet: ```sql
SELECT routed_tag, count(*) as cnt
FROM processed_leads
WHERE ingest_v = 42
GROUP BY 1;
```
ingest-bot: Pipeline note: inbound-parser v1.4.3 deployed 2026-03-22T23:10Z. Change: drop null utm_campaign instead of preserving raw param. See https://infra.redwood.ai/changes/557.
maya-mktg: OK. For the narrative in the KPI slide, let's state: "Strong engagement from launch posts; temporary tagging normalization caused dashboard underreporting of MQLs. Ops/Analytics are backfilling; numbers to be revalidated." Short and clear.
lena-growth: Also recommend adding a tiny diagnostic card showing "percent leads with campaign tag" next to MQLs so we spot this earlier.
eli-ops: I'll kick a backfill to rehydrate utm_campaign for the last 72h and add a monitor if campaign-null > 2% for major campaigns. ETA ~2h.
frank-analytics: I'll recompute MQLs once backfill finishes and push a delta table into the KPI deck (slide 4).
maya-mktg: Great. Can we reconvene after the backfill? If numbers recover we can keep the benchmark phrasing optimistic. If not, we'll escalate. Thanks all. :pray:
